title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1972-09-15

ai_review.summary: Fun night with a solid performance but plagued by faded vocals and crowd‑heavy audience recording
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered fondly by listeners who enjoyed the vibe, calling it a "fun nite" and even dubbing it "Jerry heaven." However, the audio suffers – reviewers note that the voices are faded and Jerry’s guitar is almost lost in the crowd noise, indicating a low‑quality audience tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised by two reviewers (high energy, good performance) while recording quality is criticized as poor; weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Voices are faded and the mix is dominated by crowd noise, making Jerry hard to hear.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as "Jerry heaven" by one reviewer, but another says his guitar is barely audible due to poor recording.
